title: Google increases the storage of its $19.99/month AI Pro subscription plan to 5TB, up from 2TB, at no additional cost (Abner Li/9to5Google)
summary: Abner Li / 9to5Google: Google increases the storage of its $19.99/month AI Pro subscription plan to 5TB, up from 2TB, at no additional cost — Google today announced that AI Pro subscriptions now come with 5 TB of storage. — Previously, subscribers of the $19.99 per month plan got 2 TB, just like the $9.99 tier.
